claims.claim: A marriage certificate is needed as evidence when you change your name.
claims.note: A marriage certificate is listed as evidence HMRC may accept when it asks you to prove personal details showing your date of birth, but the text does not say it is needed to report a name change.

claims.claim: A deed poll is needed as evidence when you change your name.
claims.note: The text does not mention a deed poll.

claims.claim: You need a Government Gateway account to update your HMRC records.
claims.quote: Tell HMRC your name has changed . You’ll need to sign in. If you do not already have sign in details you’ll be able to create them.
claims.note: The text says you need to sign in but does not name Government Gateway.

claims.claim: You can use your personal tax account to update your HMRC records.
claims.quote: tell HMRC about a change of name or address
claims.note: The personal tax account page lists telling HMRC about a change of name or address among the things you can do.
